message.content: GPX files from Komoot are routes (`<rte>`), not tracks. Can trailhead read those too?

aiTitle: Read routes as well as tracks

content.text:
Yes. A route is a list of `<rtept>` without timestamps, so distance and elevation work and pace doesn't.

I changed `gpx::read_track` to take `<trkpt>` and, if there are none, `<rtept>`, and added `tests/fixtures/komoot-route.gpx`. A route prints `–` for its moving time.
